consulted_during: round 3 after seed 320 completed; active program unchanged
source_kind: Transcribed original Activision Seaquest instruction manual, linked by official ALE documentation
source_reported_rule: Surfacing with no divers costs the submarine; surfacing with fewer than six costs one diver. Holding fire requests continuous torpedoes; horizontal movement also sets facing.
observed_training_context: Round 3 seed 320 reached the surface near decision 786 with carried_divers=0 and then entered unavailable animation before the 800-decision cap. This resembles the manual rule but is not a validated per-frame cause classifier.
research_implication: Later proposals may explicitly collect at least one diver before an oxygen-return cycle. This adds external game-rule knowledge as well as training feedback, preventing a feedback-only causal claim.
